title: Unpinned `dsh plugin add` resolves an out-of-step npm `latest` tag and gets rejected as incompatible

reported.symptom: `dsh plugin --profile web add @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` (unpinned) was rejected: the package's npm latest tag points at 0.0.1-rc.1, whose @deepseek-ai/dsh-* peers are ^0.0.1-rc.1
reported.runtime_trace: npm dist-tags are out of step inside the scope: mcp-client latest=0.0.1-rc.1 while dsh latest=0.2.1-rc.2; the install message named the unmet requirements
user_hypotheses: the MCP client needs a separate install (it does not: pinning the matching version installs cleanly and the tools register)
reported.root_cause: an unpinned spec resolved a first-release candidate whose peer ranges exclude the running 0.2.1-rc.2
reported.fix_verified_by_reporter: `dsh plugin --profile web add @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client@0.2.1-rc.2` then 35 mcp__chrome__* tools registered on arm64 Linux

deviations: no installation existed (upstream refused it), so this case is recorded in `candidate` mode: admission on the manifest that the unpinned spec resolved
the dist-tag resolution itself is not re-simulated; the resolved version comes from the report and its real published manifest
